name: linear_issue_creator_ts
description: Creates a Linear issue on a chosen team through the Linear GraphQL API, resolving the team by key or name first and mapping a readable priority onto Linear's numeric scale.

description.description: Optional markdown body for the issue.

priority.description: none, urgent, high, medium or low, or an integer 0-4.

apiKey.description: Linear personal API key; falls back to the LINEAR_API_KEY environment variable.
